reason: Fixed-feature head search exhausted its budget at validation mAP 0.2749. An unselected v1 fine-tune attempt was interrupted before its first epoch completed because repeated high-resolution JPEG decoding was too slow; v2 caches resized uint8 images once.
scope: Validation-driven fine-tuning of the final ResNet18 block on native SeaClear multilabel image-presence annotations
selection: Highest two-seed mean validation macro average precision. Compare against parent validation mAP, never parent test results.
stopping_rule: Four validation-driven configurations in four rounds. Two consecutive configurations without at least 0.005 improvement over best-so-far are a bounded fine-tuning plateau, not a global optimum.
heldout_policy: Reuse locked site splits and supported-category list. Lock all fine-tuned checkpoints and choose the model using validation labels only. Refit decision threshold on calibration and evaluate test once.
